name: buddy
description: Buddy: a pet sidekick for Claude Code. Sees all your chats, keeps your to-do list when Claude needs you, covers your secrets while you film, runs a team of helper agents and background chats, manages your skills, warns before a cold-cache message, and asks before sends and paid calls

myEmail.title: My email
myEmail.description: Where 'Send to me first' sends a test copy. Leave empty to hide that button.

sendGate.title: Send gate
sendGate.description: Hold emails, DMs, posts, uploads, pushes and deploys until you approve

spendGate.title: Spend gate
spendGate.description: Hold paid API calls (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ElevenLabs, Replicate, fal, Runway, HeyGen, Apify and any you add) until you approve

dangerGuard.title: Danger guard
dangerGuard.description: Hold folder deletes, wildcard deletes, git wipes, force pushes and database drops until you approve. Off by default; switch it on in the Jobs tab.

agentWatcher.title: Agent watcher
agentWatcher.description: List every subagent in Buddy's pane

lockedFiles.title: Locked files
lockedFiles.description: Comma-separated names or path endings Claude may not edit, e.g. .env, contracts/, finances.xlsx

houseRules.title: House rules
houseRules.description: Rules Buddy reminds Claude of at the start of every chat (one per line or separated by ;)

bannedPhrases.title: Banned phrases
bannedPhrases.description: Comma-separated words or characters Buddy flags if they appear in a reply, e.g. —, delve

donePingSeconds.title: Done ping after (seconds)
donePingSeconds.description: Buddy pops up when a task that took longer than this finishes

codexEnabled.title: Codex sidekick
codexEnabled.description: Let Buddy run OpenAI Codex for second opinions. Off by default: it sends the task and code you name to OpenAI. Read-only.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Model Buddy asks Codex to use

cacheMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
cacheMinutes.description: How long Claude's prompt cache stays warm after a reply. 5 for most setups; 60 if you use the 1-hour cache.

paidApis.title: Extra paid APIs
paidApis.description: Add your own paid services for the spend gate, comma-separated hosts (e.g. api.stripe.com, api.twilio.com). Popular AI APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, ElevenLabs, Replicate, fal, Runway, HeyGen, Apify and more) are already covered.

hideNames.title: Hide on screen
hideNames.description: Names recording mode covers on screen, like clients or your company. Comma-separated.

cacheAskAbove.title: Cache check above ($)
cacheAskAbove.description: Buddy asks before a cold-cache message only when it would cost more than this, at API rates

threadPermission.title: Separate chats permission mode
threadPermission.description: Permission mode for separate background chats Buddy starts: acceptEdits (default), default, plan or bypassPermissions
